title: Shonen Jump Cancels Major 2026 Series Before It Got to End Its Story
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has now cancelled its third major series of 2026, but this one didn’t even try to end its story. It’s now the start of a new quarter for Shonen Jump, and that means they are going to get ready to introduce some new serializations in the hopes that they take off with fans.
author: ComicBook

title: 9 Years After Controversial Remake, This 10/10 Classic Sci-Fi Anime Shares New Reboot Trailer
content: One of the most prominent science-fiction anime and manga franchises is coming back for a new reboot nine years after a very controversial remake, and fans can check it out with a new trailer ahead of its premiere later this Summer.
author: ComicBook

title: All 12 Episodes of Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3, Ranked
content: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 has come to an end with a total of 12 episodes, covering the first part of the Culling Game arc and teasing how this sorcerer tournament stands in a league of its own.
author: ComicBook

title: Frieren Season 2 Does Almost Nothing (And That’s Why It’s Incredible)
content: As Winter 2026 comes to an end, so do many ongoing anime, including the second season of Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End , one of the most popular titles of the season. With its debut alone, the anime generated significant buzz, even dethroning its first season to become the highest-rated anime on MyAnimeList.
author: ComicBook

title: 5 Best Anime for Jujutsu Kaisen Fans While They Wait for Season 4
content: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 has officially brought the first part of the Culling Game arc to a close, and it could be a while before Season 4 picks up with the latter half. Fortunately, Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 is already confirmed — but there’s no word on a release date for the coming episodes, which is disappointing…

title: 17 Years Later, Soul Eater Returns in a Shocking Fire Force Final Season Twist
content: Warning! Massive spoilers for Fire Force Season 3 Episode 24 to follow! Fire Force is now rounding out the final episodes of the anime’s third and final season, and the penultimate episode of the series just made a wild direct connection to creator Atsushi Okubo’s previous work, Soul Eater.

title: One Piece Drops First Look Trailer for New Spinoff Anime All About Nami
content: One Piece fans are gearing up for a huge rest of the year, and now fans have gotten the first full look a its new spinoff anime all about Nami. One Piece has been having a huge year thanks to not only the release of the second season of the live-action series with Netflix, but also a brand new era of the anime coming…

title: After 31 Years, A Legendary Isekai Returns With Reboot Anime This Fall (Watch New Trailer)
content: A legendary Isekai franchise is coming back with a brand new reboot 31 years after its original TV anime series came to an end, and a new trailer has been released to help celebrate its upcoming Fall 2026 premiere.

title: Trigun Stargaze Stars Talk Future of The Franchise, Their Characters Avoiding Death (Exclusive)
content: The final episode of Trigun Stargaze is here, bringing to an end the anime sensation that offered new takes on the likes of Vash the Stampede, Meryl Strife, Milly Thompson, and Nicholas D. Wolfwood.

title: Gintama Creator’s New Anime Confirms Netflix Release Date With Trailer
content: The creator behind legendary Shonen Jump series Gintama is getting a brand new anime with Netflix later this April, and the new series has confirmed its release date with Netflix in a new trailer and poster showing it all off.
